title: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Framework
summary: OAuth 2.0 is a framework for authorization, enabling third-party applications to obtain limited access to a user's resources.

content.overview: OAuth 2.0 provides a method for clients to access server resources on behalf of a resource owner.
content.details: It defines a process where a resource owner grants permission to a client to access a protected resource from a resource server, without sharing credentials.
